Do not use a catheter valve when bladder filling could harm the kidneys, such as with a high-pressure bladder or urinary reflux, or when continuous drainage is required. It is also unsuitable if the person cannot reliably operate it or follow an emptying schedule without caregiver support; a clinician should assess suitability. A catheter valve does not measure urine volume, so the shared note is incorrect.

CONFIDENCE: 94
